name: Jawg Maps
tagline: French OSM map platform with tiles, geocoding, directions, and static maps
description: Jawg Maps provides raster and vector maps, geocoding and reverse geocoding, routing, static maps, place search, and elevation using access-token authentication. Its free Basic plan is restricted to non-commercial use on publicly available websites without login.

auth.details: Access token (access-token query param or Authorization: Bearer). Self-serve signup via Jawg Lab.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic: 25,000 map views/month; 5,000/month each for static maps, place search, navigation, and elevation; 1 custom style. Limited to non-commercial use on publicly available websites without login.

rate_limits: Default limits per account and IP: Maps 100 requests/second; Static Maps, Elevation, Places, and Routing 1 request/second each.
use_cases: reverse geocode lat/lon to a place name
request driving or walking directions between points
render map tiles or static map images for a location
